artists.biography:
Andy Bell (born Andrew Ivan Bell on 25 April 1964 in Peterborough, U.K.) is a singer-songwriter known for being the lead singer of the synthpop duo Erasure, with musical partner Vince Clarke, as well as for his solo career, Bell has sold over twenty million albums worldwide.
Electric Blue, Bell's first solo album, was released in 2005 and includes collaborations with Claudia Brucken of Propaganda and Jake Shears of Scissor Sisters. It was co-written and produced by Philip Larsen and Chris Smith of Manhattan Clique. Single "Crazy" became a club anthem. He followed the album up in 2010 with Non-Stop.
Andy Bell is one of the first openly gay singers in pop music.  He revealed his HIV-positive status in 2004 (he had suffered from the disease since 1998), successfully fighting the disease throughout his career.  In the past several years, he has also found success both as a DJ and as a remixer.

perplexity.description:
Flicker is Andy Bell's second solo album, released in February 2022 through Sonic Cathedral. An 18-track double album, it represents a substantial artistic statement that builds upon the foundation established by his 2020 debut, The View from Halfway Down. The album showcases Bell's work in rock and indie-pop territory, demonstrating his continued exploration of melodic songwriting and atmospheric production following his departure from Ride.

The album was made available in multiple formats, including both CD and double-LP editions, with special colored vinyl variants released through independent record retailers. Flicker marked a significant point in Bell's post-Ride career, establishing him as a solo artist capable of sustaining extended album-length projects. The work has remained part of his active discography, with subsequent releases including collaborative work and acoustic reinterpretations of songs from the album appearing on the 2023 compilation Strange Loops & Outer Psych.
